curation_constraints: No quantitative observations: original table units are percent; source analysis dates are absent; no invented mg/kg conversion or date.

Separate Fe(II) concentration from total Fe and from metal recovery.
Do not treat rising relative Ti/Al solid contents as net microbial accumulation; unresolved mass changes and denominator matter.
No strain accession, material identifier or criticality claim unless independently established.
Preserve unspecified waste sterilization, inoculum carry-over chemistry, pH reagent, agitation, replicates, detection limits and mass balance.
